tradition.name: Deep Progressive House
tradition.lineage: Deep progressive house cultivates the restrained, groove-led side of progressive dance music through specialist labels, remix networks and gradual DJ programming. Pads, rolling bass and detailed percussion build atmosphere without requiring a large festival climax.

extras.description: Long transitions let bass movement, percussion and atmospheric layers develop together. Selectors connect tracks through pacing and texture, often placing these sounds in the earlier, deeper portions of extended sets.

entries.geo_rationale: Firsthand founder identifies Toronto base; editorial label-network anchor, not exclusive origin of the international field.
entries.model_policy: Representative documented DJ selection/mixing practice, positively described by the label founder and accompanied by his published Progressive Astronaut mix. This does not turn an opaque produced master into a sampler. All embedded bass, pad, percussion and occasional vocal material remains in the selected recordings; no physical generator, live singer count, source decks or track inventory is guessed. Controlled live-room presentation is authored. No global tuning. Production itself is a separate documented branch, retained in history rather than reconstructed as source hardware.
entries.neighbor_distinction: The full existing progressive_house already spans the1992 British evolving-groove lineage and later festival variants; it is not reduced to festival music. Deep Progressive is a narrower ongoing curatorial/production specialization inside that umbrella. Deep Down founder explicitly describes selective early-set programming, a deep/chuggy sound and an A&R/remix network including GMJ, Alex O’Rion and Dowden; Perspectives founder independently identifies an initial Deep Progressive catalog before expansion into melodic techno and other styles. Exact creator map includes these network members. The boundary is positively organized specialization rather than a new artist, era, lower tempo alone, or a claim of disjoint sonic grammar. It overlaps deep/organic/melodic house; not asserted synonymous with any whole umbrella.

tradition.name: Myanmar Hip Hop
tradition.lineage: Myanmar hip-hop grew through local rap collectives, home recording and informal circulation before expanding into concerts, studios and online networks. extras.description: Rhythmic vocal lines meet assembled beats and bass-led backing. Direct speech, hooks and contrasting flows carry personal and social subjects; sampling, electronic production and popular-song crossover broaden the sound.

tradition.lineage: Contemporary urban music in the Republic of the Congo connects rap, slam and popular dance-song communities through Brazzaville, recording studios, festivals and online networks.

extras.description: Rhythmic speech, melodic hooks and produced beats circulate alongside local dance rhythms and rumba-derived approaches. Artists move between rap, slam, Afro-pop and other popular forms, making this a shared regional scene rather than a single instrumental formula. A rapper over a produced beat represents one active branch.

tradition.name: Reading
tradition.lineage: Music for reading is a functional listening field cultivated by composers, publishers and playlist curators. Quiet piano, ambient textures and restrained instrumental arrangements provide a continuous backdrop to books and other sustained reading.

extras.description: Connected melodic phrases and unobtrusive harmony leave space around the listener’s attention. Gentle dynamics and slowly unfolding musical continuity favor immersion over abrupt changes or foreground vocal storytelling.

entries.geo_rationale: Approximate Norwegian land anchor for documented composer-publisher example; reading music is international, not confined to Norway.

Issuer explicitly identifies solo piano and reading use; standard studio upright is an authored instrument construction, connected legato/pedal-resonant phrases preserve low-interruption musical continuity. No exact original piano mechanism, measured tempo, improved comprehension or medical benefit asserted. Full three controls retained; live-room is authored. entries.neighbor_distinction: Full background_music is the broad subordinate-listening umbrella; reading is a positively marketed and curated use-context subset, not an exclusion from it. Full focus_beats specifies instrumental beat-making for concentration, while reading can use quiet nonbeat solo piano or ambient material. Queued Focus spans general concentration; reading specifically centers sustained book/text engagement. New Age Piano describes a musical-production lineage rather than this use-context across styles. Exact overlap is acknowledged; no claim the same piano music cannot serve several functions.
entries.classification_evidence: Spotify editorial Reading Chill Out explicitly selects calm music for reading. Composer-owned SoothingRelaxation markets its solo-piano BrightFuture specifically for reading as well as other quiet uses. These independent creator/publisher practices support the field without requiring exclusivity or health efficacy.
